items.title: Windows: everyday shortcuts
items.body:
Win+D          show desktop           Win+E        File Explorer
Win+L          lock screen            Win+R        Run dialog
Win+I          Settings               Win+X        power-user menu
Win+V          clipboard history      Win+.        emoji panel
Win+Shift+S    screenshot (snip)      PrtScn       full screenshot
Ctrl+Shift+Esc Task Manager           Alt+F4       close window
Alt+Tab        switch windows         Win+Tab      task view

items.title: Windows: window snapping and desktops
items.body:
Win+Left / Right     snap window to half screen
Win+Up / Down        maximise / restore or minimise
Win+Shift+Left/Right move window to another monitor
Win+Ctrl+D           new virtual desktop
Win+Ctrl+Left/Right  switch desktops
Win+Ctrl+F4          close current desktop
Win+P                projection / display mode

items.title: Windows: text editing
items.body:
Ctrl+C / X / V   copy / cut / paste        Ctrl+Z / Y    undo / redo
Ctrl+A           select all                Ctrl+F        find
Ctrl+Left/Right  move by word              Ctrl+Backspace  delete previous word
Home / End       start / end of line       Ctrl+Home/End   start / end of document
Shift+arrows     extend selection          Ctrl+Shift+arrows  select by word

items.title: Windows: File Explorer
items.body:
F2 rename     F5 refresh      Alt+Up  parent folder    Alt+Left/Right  back/forward
Ctrl+Shift+N new folder      Shift+Delete delete permanently
Ctrl+E search box   Alt+D address bar   Alt+Enter properties
Shift+right-click: more options (e.g. open PowerShell here)

items.title: Browser shortcuts
items.body:
Ctrl+T new tab         Ctrl+W close tab        Ctrl+Shift+T reopen closed tab
Ctrl+Tab next tab      Ctrl+1..8 go to tab n   Ctrl+L focus address bar
Ctrl+R / F5 reload     Ctrl+Shift+R hard reload (ignore cache)
F12 or Ctrl+Shift+I developer tools   Ctrl+Shift+J console (Chrome)
Ctrl+D bookmark        Ctrl+H history          Ctrl+Shift+Delete clear data
Ctrl+Shift+N / P incognito / private window

items.title: Windows Terminal / PowerShell
items.body:
Ctrl+C          stop the running command (copy if text selected)
Ctrl+Shift+C/V  copy / paste in Windows Terminal
Up / Down       command history      F7  history list (cmd)
Tab             autocomplete         Ctrl+L / cls  clear screen
Ctrl+Shift+T    new tab              Alt+Shift+D  duplicate pane
Ctrl+Shift+P    command palette

items.title: Linux terminal (bash) shortcuts
items.body:
Ctrl+C  interrupt        Ctrl+Z  suspend (fg to resume)    Ctrl+D  end input / logout
Ctrl+L  clear screen     Ctrl+R  reverse history search
Ctrl+A / E  start / end of line     Alt+B / F  back / forward a word
Ctrl+U  delete to start  Ctrl+K  delete to end   Ctrl+W  delete previous word
Ctrl+Y  paste what was deleted      !!  repeat last command    !$  last argument

items.title: Android: buttons and gestures
items.body:
Screenshot:       Power + Volume Down
Power menu:       hold Power (some phones: Power + Volume Up)
Notifications:    swipe down from the top; swipe down again for Quick Settings
Back:             swipe in from the left or right edge (gesture navigation)
Home:             swipe up from the bottom
Recent apps:      swipe up and hold; swipe sideways to switch apps
Quick app switch: swipe along the bottom edge
Force restart:    hold Power (about 10-30 s) until the phone restarts
items.description: Details vary by manufacturer and Android version.

items.title: Android: text and system tips
items.body:
Select a word: double-tap       Select all / Copy / Paste: long-press in a text field
Dictation: microphone key on the keyboard
Split screen: from Recents, tap the app icon > Split screen (varies)
Screen pinning: Settings > Security > App pinning
Developer options: tap Build number 7 times in About phone

items.title: Android with a hardware keyboard
items.body:
Ctrl+C / X / V / A / Z   copy, cut, paste, select all, undo
Alt+Tab                  switch between recent apps
Tab / Shift+Tab          move focus between controls
Enter or Space           activate the focused control
Ctrl+Space               switch input language (when several are enabled)
items.description: Basics that work with Bluetooth or USB keyboards (support varies by app and device).

items.title: macOS equivalents
items.body:
Cmd+C/X/V copy, cut, paste    Cmd+Z undo    Cmd+Shift+Z redo
Cmd+Tab switch apps          Cmd+Space Spotlight   Cmd+Q quit app
Cmd+Shift+4 area screenshot  Cmd+Shift+3 full screenshot
Cmd+Option+Esc force quit    Ctrl+Cmd+Q lock screen
items.description: Cmd replaces Ctrl for most shortcuts.

items.title: Excel and Google Sheets shortcuts
items.body:
Ctrl+Arrow jump to data edge      Ctrl+Shift+Arrow select to edge
Ctrl+; insert today's date        Ctrl+Shift+; insert time
F4 repeat last action / toggle $ in a reference ($A$1)
Ctrl+D fill down                  Ctrl+R fill right
Alt+= AutoSum                     Ctrl+Space / Shift+Space select column / row

items.title: VS Code essentials (recap)
items.body:
Ctrl+P open file      Ctrl+Shift+P commands     Ctrl+D next match
Ctrl+/ comment         Alt+Up/Down move line     Ctrl+` terminal
Ctrl+B sidebar         F12 definition            F2 rename symbol

items.title: Screenshots on different systems
items.body:
Windows:  Win+Shift+S (region), PrtScn (full), Alt+PrtScn (active window)
macOS:    Cmd+Shift+3 (full), Cmd+Shift+4 (region), Cmd+Shift+5 (options)
Linux:    PrtScn (full), Shift+PrtScn (region) on most desktops
Android:  Power + Volume Down
Chrome DevTools: Ctrl+Shift+P then "Capture full size screenshot"
items.description: Capture the screen or a region.
